brief: Open-front post-and-beam loafing and machine shed, about 39 ft by 16 ft: the south side is entirely open, its low eave carried on six crooked peeled hedge-apple (Osage orange) posts, while the back and ends are closed with weathered grey boards patched with corrugated metal. A new dark charcoal asphalt-shingle gable roof. Inside: old tires, a steel barrel, a harrow, a walking cultivator and rusty implements on a dirt floor; mown grass in front and big shade trees behind.
